UserNotificationToken.title: UserNotificationToken
UserNotificationToken.description: FCM registration token and per-topic notification preferences for a signed-in user.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the token owner.

fcmToken.description: Firebase Cloud Messaging device token (empty string if pending).

liveEnabled.description: Whether push notifications for live streams are enabled.

videosEnabled.description: Whether push notifications for new YouTube videos are enabled.

socialEnabled.description: Whether push notifications for new Instagram posts are enabled.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the document was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the document was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

AppStatus.title: AppStatus
AppStatus.description: Backend-managed status documents for live stream detection, latest video, and latest social highlight.

liveActive.description: Whether the YouTube channel is currently live.

title.description: Title of the current live stream or latest item.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last backend check.

SocialPost.title: SocialPost
SocialPost.description: Synced social media post from @cccristoreyve populated via webhook or backend sync.

imageUrl.description: Image URL for the social post.

postUrl.description: Permalink to the original Instagram post.

published.description: Visibility flag for published community posts.

publishedAt.description: Formatted or ISO publication timestamp string.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when stored in Firestore.

/tokens/{userId}.description: Per-user FCM token and notification topic preferences keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/app_status/{statusId}.description: Read-only system status documents managed by Cloud Functions.

/social_posts/{postId}.description: Read-only published Instagram posts synced by Cloud Functions webhook.
